title: Detailed standing32 acquisition completed; admission rejected
summary: All 8,000 steps across 32 replicas were captured, but only 11/32 passed native physical and quiet checks. The host separately exceeded 600 seconds. A new 32/4 solver diagnostic requires the unobserved installed 32/1 precondition and fresh one-then-32 admission; the 1,200-second operational budget changes no quality gate. No detailed-model PPO has run.
